correctness.rationale: Fink's formula reduces pristineness exactly to \(F_7(c)=q^7\). Exact expansion gives \(5040F_7(c)=(c+8)G(c)\) with \(G(-8)=-2^{14}3^2\), hence \(\gcd(c+8,G(c))\mid2^{14}3^2\). For \(q\ge11\), \(q\) divides only one factor; the elementary lower bound \(F_7(c)>c^7/5040\) gives \(c<4q\), excluding \(q^7\mid c+8\) and forcing \(c+8\le5040\). For \(q=3,5,7\), the same growth bound gives the smaller \(c<28\). Fresh exact arithmetic checked the polynomial identity and every \(1\le c\le5032\); no value is a seventh power. The finite scan is therefore exhaustive only after the proved cutoff.
